newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-TVL WIN TOSS, BAT FIRST VS E.P.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-TVL WIN TOSS, BAT FIRST VS E.P.

text.p: Transvaal captain Ken Rutherford won the toss and elected to bat on the opening day of his side's Supersport Series four-day match against Eastern Province at the Wanderers on Friday.
Transvaal - Adam Bacher, Mark Benfield, Neil McKenzie, Ken Rutherford, Dean Laing, Nic Pothas, Ross Veenstra, Andrew Hall, Clive Eksteen, Wayne Kidwell, Rowan Lyle.
Eastern Province - Philip Amm, Mark Rushmere, Louis Koen, Kepler Wessels, Dave Callaghan, Grant Morgan, Eldine Baptiste, Tim Shaw, Wickus Botha, Quentin Ferreira, Mornantau Hayward.
